Automated financial reconciliation with the Claude API, recovering 20 hours per week and clearing a nine-month backlog in a single week, with schema validation so no malformed AI output reached the database
Cut daily reporting from 2 hours per site to 15 minutes across all 3, auto-flagging cash variance by responsible employee
Cut multi-location KPI tracking from roughly 6 hours daily to 45 minutes through reporting automations
Analyzed 60K+ monthly transactions in SQL to surface margin leakage and site-level performance gaps, informing pricing decisions
Built a Claude-powered pricing engine recommending retail price adjustments from real-time cost fluctuations, run as a proof of concept justified by the 60K+ transaction margin analysis

Ran discovery before each build: mapped the manual workflows with ownership and management roles (current state to future state), then prioritized automation candidates by the hours and cost each would recover
Trained and onboarded the 14 staff on the Slack workflows personally, driving adoption among non-technical users
Documented the automations: runbooks, user guides, and the workflow rules the Slack assistant works from
Built human-in-the-loop review into the AI workflows: output that fails schema validation, and AI drafts, go to a person for review before use
Sustained 99% reliability across scheduled production automations with retry logic, deduplication, structured logging, and daily monitoring
Built inventory and demand forecasting logic triggering orders days in advance, holding zero stockouts through a regional supply shortage
Raised brand compliance audit scores from 60-65% to 99% across 3 locations by setting and enforcing brand and operational standards
Relaunched an in-house food brand with redesigned menus, signage, and promotional activation, lifting daily revenue 87% (from roughly $800 to $1,500 daily average)
Launched a social media and promotional signage program supporting foot traffic and cross-sell revenue
Built AI content workflows (research, drafting, editing) using the Claude API
Built Power BI dashboards for ownership reporting
End-to-end ownership across 3 locations, reporting directly to ownership, with 14 staff reporting to this role (operational leadership, not marketing-team management)

roles.title: Performance Marketing Manager
roles.context: Regulated healthcare services: an at-home healthcare booking platform

facts.text: Sole owner of the entire marketing function, with no reports and no hires
Grew online appointments 300% in twelve months by owning paid media across Meta, Google, and retargeting, iterating on targeting and landing pages through controlled A/B tests
Managed paid search on Google end to end: keyword research, bid management, negative keyword collection, and budget pacing
Increased repeat customer rate 37%, measured by repeat booking frequency, by aligning paid media messaging with the downstream customer experience alongside sales and operations
Implemented Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking to measure CPA, ROAS, and funnel KPIs, sharpening budget decisions
Defined success metrics and KPI targets before launch, then reallocated budget toward high-performing segments after validating results across sufficient sample sizes
Built reporting dashboards joining ad platform data with CRM data, giving stakeholders a clear view of campaign performance and budget efficiency
Executed geo-targeted campaigns across 200+ Dubai localities with tailored, bilingual creative, driving more qualified conversions in specific service areas
Built a content marketing funnel with email automation segmenting prospects by engagement level, moving them toward conversion
Built an internal WordPress booking and billing CRM, cutting appointment scheduling time 75%
Gathered booking and billing workflow requirements with sales and operations staff before building that CRM
Developed brand identity and editorial voice from scratch across all marketing channels, and designed print, web, and social content in-house
Presented funnel KPIs and performance reports with actionable recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Trained customer service and business development staff on upselling, cross-selling, and pitching service packages, translating campaign messaging into the sales conversation

roles.title: Digital Marketing & Performance Manager
roles.context: Agency serving 15-20 concurrent B2B and B2C client accounts

facts.text: Managed USD 272,000 in cumulative paid search and paid social spend across 15-20 client accounts, allocating budgets on funnel performance, attribution insight, and keyword-level data
Delivered 189% average ROAS across conversion campaigns using negative keyword lists and continuous bid optimization to cut wasted spend
Lifted campaign click-through rate from 11% to 43% through structured creative and audience testing, setting success thresholds before scaling and adjusting bids on quality score data

Improved lead quality 30%, measured by sales-qualified lead rate, by redesigning full-funnel acquisition, refining segmentation to reach decision-makers and C-level buyers, and aligning messaging with buyer intent
Increased client retention 100% year over year by proposing forward roadmaps in the final month of each contract

Built the agency's first paid media capability from zero: before this role the agency sold organic social media management only. Established the paid service line across paid search and paid social, retargeting, budget optimization, and CRO, then trained the wider team to deliver it and taught business development how to pitch and price it

Built the agency's digital marketing division from scratch: service portfolio (social media management, SEO, SMM, paid search and paid social, retargeting, CRO, web development, app development), prospecting, and training sales staff to pitch it
Hired 2 marketers into the division, defining the roles, selecting the candidates, and onboarding them onto campaign setup and optimization workflows
Mentored 3 junior marketers on campaign setup, bidding, and optimization workflows
Managed photographers, designers, copywriters, SEO specialists, and models, directing social posts, ads, blogs, and product copy, while performing each of those functions when the bench was thin
Defined testing roadmaps for creative, targeting, and funnel structure with pre-set success thresholds guiding optimization and budget reallocation

Shipped 12 WordPress websites across e-commerce, travel and hospitality, F&B, retail, B2B corporate, and education technology, scoping each client's requirements and running each site from discovery through go-live
Ran kickoff and onboarding for new clients, including an audit of each account's tracking and ad setup
Increased inquiries 45% and conversion to client 68% after the first consultation call
Developed a marketing portfolio in Adobe Photoshop that won the agency three new client contracts
Acted as primary liaison between clients, internal execution teams, and external partners, translating performance data into recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders
Delivered performance reports covering wins, improvement areas, roadmaps, and new campaign ideas to every client

Food Crowd (e-commerce grocery): rebuilt content strategy and funnel, launched stage-specific paid campaigns, produced video for an influencer box product line. CPA $2.66, AOV $49.52, ROAS 18.6, orders up 67%, revenue up 42%. Ranked them on Google page one for highly competitive keywords within 9 months through SEO

Bagason Industries (FMCG): brand awareness campaigns across local supermarkets plus micro-influencer PR kits, driving 225% brand recall over a 12-month cycle, measured in Meta Ads Manager campaign reports

Robostores (B2B e-commerce fulfillment): lead generation on Meta and LinkedIn, content strategy with blogs and lead magnets, website redesign. Lead quality up 22%, measured by consultation meetings booked

J5 Hotels (hospitality): first website with online booking, cinematic photo and video content, social channel launch on Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Website CTR 77% at launch through targeted A/B testing

F&B and hospitality portfolio: organic social, paid social, content, and conversion campaigns for Forever Rose Cafe, Machu Picchu Restaurant, Late Lounge Cafe, Around Eleven Cafe, Lucerne Restaurant Abu Dhabi
